verdict.rationale: A tax agency with machine channels (EDI, approved franchise-tax preparer software, a Socrata open-data rail) could plausibly publish a test or certification environment, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox. The keyless open-data endpoint is a live production read rail, not a test environment. Filing and payment surfaces exist only behind authenticated eSystems sessions, and no OpenAPI or developer docs were found.
